resources.string: YouTube ad auto-advance is not supported yet. The switch stays disabled until a real Shorts-feed ad screen is verified. Planned scope excludes creator sponsorships and ads in regular videos.
You can save the delay in advance; it does not skip ads now. Planned range: 0.0–9.9 seconds, in 0.1-second steps. 0.0 will mean no extra wait after safety checks, not off.
Awaiting an ad-screen check · Auto-advance currently unsupported
